references.text: The description of the incense and its holy composition that was to be used in the tabernacle, which is what the golden bowl was filled with.
The first time the golden bowl with incense is mentioned in the offerings from the tribal leaders, establishing the pattern for all twelve tribes' gifts.
A summary of all twelve golden bowls filled with incense, confirming that each tribe gave the same offering.
Golden bowls mentioned in connection with the tabernacle equipment, showing the use of gold in sanctuary service.
Incense used in sanctuary service, especially on the Day of Atonement, illustrating the holy function of the incense.
Golden bowls filled with incense in heaven, representing the prayers of the saints, a typological fulfillment of the tabernacle's incense offering.
Incense offered on the golden altar before the throne, linking the tabernacle's incense offering to heavenly worship.
